query: SELECT id,status,version FROM repair_ticket WHERE id=3; SELECT id,user_id,space_id,status,version FROM feedback_report WHERE id=3; SELECT report_id,action,COUNT(*) AS count FROM feedback_history WHERE report_id=3 GROUP BY report_id,action; SELECT report_id,media_type,width,height,OCTET_LENGTH(content) AS bytes,sha256 FROM feedback_attachment WHERE report_id=3; SELECT id,version,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(profile_json,"$.conditions.outletCondition")) AS outlet_condition FROM space WHERE id=2017; SELECT id,status,version,source_round FROM preparation_batch WHERE id=2; SELECT id,batch_id,user_id,current_version,status FROM preparation_application WHERE batch_id=2; SELECT application_id,revision,preferences_json FROM application_version WHERE application_id=3 ORDER BY revision; SELECT COUNT(*) AS formal_results FROM allocation_result WHERE batch_id=2; SELECT event_id,user_id,status,sequence_number,version FROM event_participation WHERE event_id=2; SELECT recipient_id,entity_type,entity_id,COUNT(*) AS notices,SUM(delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AS delivered FROM notification_outbox WHERE (entity_type="FEEDBACK" AND entity_id=3) OR (entity_type="BATCH" AND entity_id=2) GROUP BY recipient_id,entity_type,entity_id;
